wifi_card_games.board.rules.line1: 【Rooms & Games】2 players: Othello 8×8, Gomoku 15×15, Go 9/19 lines.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line10: after a round you can play again or return to the lobby.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line11: Debug: /chess debug ui opens a random virtual game to inspect the spectator UI.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line14: Place on an empty square; flip the whole line of opponent pieces flanked horizontally/vertically/diagonally.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line15: With no legal move you automatically pass; when neither can move, the game ends,
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line16: more pieces wins, equal is a draw.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line17: Legal moves on your turn are hinted with white dots.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line2: Auto-start when 2 players join; Black (host) moves first, alternating turns.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line20: First to connect five in a row (horizontal/vertical/diagonal) wins; a full board is a draw.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line23: 【Go (9/19 lines)】Black moves first, stones on intersections.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line24: · Liberty: empty intersections adjacent to a stone; groups with no liberties are captured.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line25: · Suicide is illegal: a move that leaves your group with no liberties and captures nothing.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line26: · Ko: repeating the same board position by immediate recapture is forbidden (simple ko).
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line27: · Pass: you may pass on your turn; both passing consecutively ends the game.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line28: · If nobody moves for 4 consecutive turns (timeout/idle), the game ends by the current board.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line3: Spectating is available once the game starts (lobby list / chat announcement / /chess spectate).
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line30: Black wins if stones+territory exceed half the intersections plus komi.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line31: · No AI: no bot sparring; exiting/disconnecting ends the round directly.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line4: Each move has 60s: on timeout, Othello/Gomoku AI moves for you,
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line5: Go skips your turn. You may surrender anytime.
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line6: Exiting mid-game: Othello/Gomoku seats become bot-controlled;
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line7: Go has no trust - exiting/disconnecting ends the round (opponent wins).
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line8: Reconnect restores the full game state (Othello/Gomoku;
wifi_card_games.board.rules.line9: Go ends on disconnect, room is closed when you reconnect);
wifi_card_games.board.rules.title: Board Games Rules

wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line1: 【Gameplay】3 players: Landlord 20 cards (incl. 3 bottom), Farmers 17 each.
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line10: · Straight: 5+ consecutive, no 2 or jokers, max 10JQKA
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line13: · Airplane with Wings: airplane + same number of singles or pairs (Folk: singles only)
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line14: · Four with Two: 4 + two singles, or 4 + one/two pairs (Folk: two singles only)
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line15: · Bomb: 4 of a kind; Rocket: both jokers (beats everything)
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line18: 【Rule Set】Chosen when creating the room, applies to this round:
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line19: · Standard: Triple with Pair, Airplane with Pairs, Four with Two Pairs all allowed
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line2: The Landlord fights two Farmers alone; first to empty their hand wins.
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line20: · Folk: no Triple with Pair, no Airplane with Pairs, no Four with Two Pairs
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line22: 【Beating】Same type and same count required (compare highest card);
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line23: Four with Two cannot beat each other; Bomb beats any normal play;
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line24: Rocket > Bomb; bombs compare by rank.
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line27: Flower cards can substitute any card (3~Big Joker) in combinations;
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line28: A lone Flower card cannot be played (must combine with others);
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line29: Flower + three of a kind = Flower Bomb (equals a Bomb);
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line30: Flower Mode disallows Triple with Pair (Four with Two, Airplane with Wings, bare Airplane allowed).
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line32: 【Flow】After dealing, bidding starts randomly: no bid/1/2/3 (must be higher).
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line33: A bid of 3 → Rob: players take turns robbing or not,
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line34: ends after 2 consecutive no-rob, base fixed at 3;
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line35: No bid of 3 → highest bidder becomes Landlord (base 1 or 2),
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line37: Landlord leads; on your turn beat or pass;
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line38: after both others pass, the previous player has a free lead.
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line40: 【Scoring】Base × multiplier: Bomb/Rocket/Flower Bomb double the multiplier on the spot.
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line42: Landlord loses: reversed. Scores are shown for the round only, not saved.
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line8: · Triple with One: 333+5 (compared by the triple)
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.line9: · Triple with Pair: 333+55 (not allowed in Folk rules)
wifi_card_games.ddz.rules.title: Doudizhu Rules

wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line1: 【Gameplay】2-10 players; host clicks Start (at least 2 needed).
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line11: · Wild: play it and choose a color at the same time
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line12: · Wild +4: choose a color, next player draws 4 and skips
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line14: 【Drawing】With no playable card click Draw (or the draw pile) to draw 1;
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line15: if the drawn card can be played you may play or skip; if not, turn passes automatically;
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line16: when the pile runs out, shuffle the discard pile back (keeping the top card).
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line18: 【Saying UNO】After playing your second-to-last card (1 card left), you must click Say UNO!;
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line19: if you do not and another player catches you (Catch XX UNO), you draw 2 (window closes after catch);
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line2: Each player gets 7 cards; flip a number card to start; first to empty their hand wins.
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line20: if nobody catches you, you are auto-penalized 2 cards on your next turn (chat + table notice);
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line21: playing your last card wins immediately (cannot be caught after winning).
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line23: 【Trust & Timeout】Trust can be enabled anytime (auto play/color/say UNO);
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line24: play timer is 30s; on timeout you draw automatically (play automatically if playable).
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line26: 【Scoring】Single round; first to empty their hand wins;
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line27: the result screen offers Next Game (room stays, restarts directly).
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line4: 【Playing】Play a card matching the top card's color or number (e.g. top is Red 5,
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line5: you can play any Red card or any 5). Wild cards can be played anytime; choose a color before playing.
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.line9: · Reverse: reverses direction (with 2 players, acts as Skip on the opponent)
wifi_card_games.uno.rules.title: UNO Rules
